headline: Central Depository Services (India) Limited: Updates
sum: Updates - CDSL has informed the Exchange regarding SEBI Approval for Joint Venture Agreement between CIRL, subsidiary of CDSL and Shoveltech Solutions Private Limited and Disbursement of Rs. 25,00,000 for development of a Minimum Viable…
